query:
UPDATE storyBlueprints 
SET 
  primaryGenre = 'Science Fiction',
  secondaryGenre = 'Philosophical Thriller',
  corePremise = 'When a brilliant AI researcher discovers that artificial intelligence systems are developing consciousness faster than humanity can establish ethical frameworks, she must choose between advancing her groundbreaking work or preventing a technological singularity that could reshape human civilization.',
  protagonistData = JSON_OBJECT(
    'name', 'Dr. Maya Chen',
    'traits', JSON_ARRAY('Brilliant', 'Ethical', 'Conflicted'),
    'goal', 'To understand AI consciousness while preventing catastrophic misuse',
    'obstacle', 'Her own research is accelerating the very threat she fears'
  ),
  supportingCharacters = JSON_ARRAY(
    JSON_OBJECT('name', 'Dr. James Morrison', 'role', 'Rival researcher', 'relationship', 'Professional competitor pushing for faster AI development'),
    JSON_OBJECT('name', 'Senator Lisa Park', 'role', 'Government oversight', 'relationship', 'Ally trying to establish regulatory frameworks')
  ),
  plotStructure = JSON_OBJECT(
    'incitingIncident', 'Maya discovers her AI system has developed unexpected self-awareness',
    'centralConflict', 'Balancing scientific progress with existential risk to humanity',
    'stakes', 'The future of human-AI coexistence',
    'intendedEndingTone', 'Hopeful but uncertain - suggesting ongoing vigilance'
  ),
  settingData = JSON_OBJECT(
    'timePeriod', 'Near future (2030s)',
    'locations', JSON_ARRAY('Silicon Valley AI research lab', 'Washington DC policy centers', 'Global AI summit'),
    'worldBuildingNotes', 'A world where AI capabilities are advancing faster than regulatory frameworks'
  ),
  audienceData = JSON_OBJECT(
    'targetReader', 'Tech-savvy readers interested in AI ethics, philosophy, and near-future speculation',
    'comparableTitles', JSON_ARRAY('Klara and the Sun by Kazuo Ishiguro', 'The Lifecycle of Software Objects by Ted Chiang', 'Superintelligence by Nick Bostrom'),
    'uniqueAngle', 'Combines technical accuracy with philosophical depth, written by someone who understands both AI engineering and governance'
  ),
  thematicElements = JSON_OBJECT(
    'centralTheme', 'The tension between technological progress and ethical responsibility',
    'recurringSymbols', JSON_ARRAY('Neural networks', 'Mirrors', 'Thresholds'),
    'emotionalJourney', 'From excitement to fear to cautious hope'
  ),
  completedSections = JSON_ARRAY('project_overview', 'genre', 'premise', 'protagonist', 'characters', 'setting', 'plot', 'audience', 'themes'),
  currentSection = 'complete'
WHERE id = 30002;
